written: 2026-10-22, before any fit in this experiment
question: Does a larger or more regularised LightGBM beat the current preset once the new features are in?

parents.off_market: v2 features + building history + lot/garage, target log sold price
parents.list_aware: v2 features + building history, target log(sold/list)

configs.P0: current preset (off-market: lr 0.05, 1000 trees, 31 leaves; list-aware: lr 0.03, 800 trees, 63 leaves; both min_child_samples 100, reg_lambda 5)

selection_rule: Per track, among P1-P4 keep those with pooled screening MdAPE gain >= 1% vs P0 and at least 2 of 3 months improved; pick the lowest pooled MdAPE. If none qualifies, keep P0 and stop for that track.
confirmation_note: Third selection use of these months. Only the single selected config per track is run.
confirmation_gates: pooled MdAPE gain >= 1%, >= 5/6 months improved, worst month regression <= 5%, MAPE regression <= 1%, paired home-bootstrap 95% CI upper bound < 0
untouched: Reserved 2025-05 and 2025-08 folds, the 2025-12..2026-05 retrospective window, and hidden test files are not read.
